stem: What happens next in this passage after “That night, it became the most important object in the house.”?
options: The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.
Travel history is not only about roads.
Before the class trip, Mr. Lee gave each student a small paper map.
The announcer gave information about closed roads, shelters, and when power might return.
